note: Family-run campground on 70+ acres along the Elk River near Elkview, about 12 miles from Charleston; shaded RV sites in the woods, primitive tent sites along the river, furnished cabins (rented by the month), a catch-and-release pond, canoe livery. Google 4.5 over 116 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator's site (read in the browser; Cloudflare blocks plain HTTP): $45 back-in / $55 pull-through daily, $270/$330 weekly, $700 monthly incl. utilities; 50-amp full hookups; open year-round; reservations by phone. Confirmed hookups and phone booking, added year-round season and pull-throughs. Fees left as recorded ($45-55): the rate page is undated (footer 'Copyright 2023'). Note trimmed of the rates, hookups and RV Life line the fields hold.
flags: Rate date: lazykscampground.com/campground-rates/ shows $45 back-in / $55 pull-through with no year (site footer 'Copyright 2023'); the entry's fees.checked '2026' rests only on when it was read. Under the US$50 gate either way ($45 base; 'taxes and card fees apply'); the family has not stayed here; no gateway within 40 km (New River Gorge NP 54 km).

Long-stay mix (for information): monthly RV rate $700 including utilities, and all four cabins are rented only by the month ($1,700-2,100 with utilities and wifi), close to Charleston. Nightly RV rates are posted with a phone number and there is no application or approval step, so it appears to pass the five-test rule; RV sites look like the core business, not an afterthought to the canoe livery (the site never mentions canoes).
